description: Rebuild post_generator.py to generate ONE variation at a time (not two), inject few-shot examples, add new frameworks/tones, and simplify the UI accordingly
steps: Update TONE_DESCRIPTIONS dict in post_generator.py - add two new tones: 'Warm & Direct' ('Nigerian professional default - communal, specific, not performative. Says what happened and what it meant without hedging.') and 'Thinking Out Loud' ('Incomplete thoughts, admitting uncertainty, working through something publicly. The post that says I dont know yet but here is where I am.'). Keep all existing tones.

Update FRAMEWORK_DESCRIPTIONS dict in post_generator.py - add three new frameworks: 'Mid-Scene -> Context -> Reveal' ('Open in a specific moment (dialogue, decision, sensation). Fill in context. Land the insight without announcing it.'), 'Withhold the Lesson' ('Tell exactly what happened. Do not state what you learned. The reader figures it out - and remembers it longer.'), 'Ambient Authority' ('Share a working process or decision without framing it as advice. No you should. Just here is what I did and why.'). Keep all existing frameworks.

Rewrite build_post_prompt() to: (a) Generate ONE post instead of two - remove the 'Write 2 COMPLETELY DIFFERENT post variations' instruction and the ---VARIATION 1---/---VARIATION 2---/---ANALYSIS--- output format. Replace with instruction to write one excellent post, followed by a single line '---NOTE---' with a brief note on the angle/hook type used. (b) Inject 2-3 few-shot examples from core.examples using get_examples(). Place them after the voice primer and before the task instructions, labelled as 'EXAMPLES OF THE QUALITY AND TONE TO AIM FOR'. (c) Add a no_cta parameter (bool, default False) - when True, instruct the model to end the post without a question or call-to-action, just let it land. (d) Keep the different_angle and avoid_framework parameters working as before.

Update render_post_generator() UI: (a) Add a 'No CTA' checkbox in the input form (col2, after framework selector). (b) Remove the two-variation parsing logic (the regex that extracts var1/var2/analysis). Replace with: extract the post (everything before ---NOTE---) and the note (everything after ---NOTE---). Store as session_state pg_post and pg_note instead of pg_var1/pg_var2/pg_analysis. (c) Remove the for-loop over two variations. Show a single post result directly (not in an expander). Keep all the existing sub-features for the single post: Voice Validator badge, tabs (Post Text / LinkedIn Preview / Unicode Formatter), Polish button, pipeline buttons (Copy/Optimize/Hook/Visual/Save). (d) Keep the 'Different Angle' button working - it still rotates framework and regenerates. (e) Show the note (angle used) in a small caption below the post.

Update session state cleanup: replace references to pg_var1/pg_var2/pg_analysis with pg_post/pg_note throughout the function. The 'Different Angle' button's _has_prior check should look for pg_post instead of pg_var1.
Update the import at the top of post_generator.py to include: from core.examples import get_examples
acceptance_criteria: build_post_prompt() no longer contains 'Write 2 COMPLETELY DIFFERENT' or '---VARIATION 1---' or '---VARIATION 2---'
build_post_prompt() injects few-shot examples from core.examples
build_post_prompt() accepts no_cta parameter and instructs model accordingly when True
TONE_DESCRIPTIONS contains 'Warm & Direct' and 'Thinking Out Loud'
FRAMEWORK_DESCRIPTIONS contains 'Mid-Scene -> Context -> Reveal', 'Withhold the Lesson', 'Ambient Authority'
render_post_generator() displays a single post (no more two-variation loop)
All existing pipeline buttons (Copy, Optimize, Hook, Visual, Save, Polish) still present for the single post
LinkedIn Preview tab still works for the single post
verification: Run pytest tests/ -ra --tb=short - all tests pass

Run python -c "from post_generator import build_post_prompt; p = build_post_prompt('test topic', 'tech', 'Conversational', 'Personal Story Arc', 'founders'); assert 'VARIATION 1' not in p; assert 'EXAMPLES' in p; print('OK')"
Run python -c "from post_generator import TONE_DESCRIPTIONS, FRAMEWORK_DESCRIPTIONS; assert 'Warm & Direct' in TONE_DESCRIPTIONS; assert 'Withhold the Lesson' in FRAMEWORK_DESCRIPTIONS; print('OK')"
